metadata.description: Download videos from 1800+ platforms and generate AI summaries (TypeScript + Bun, whisper.cpp transcription)

plugins.name: video-summarizer
plugins.description: Download videos from YouTube, Bilibili, Twitter/X, TikTok and 1800+ platforms. Outputs subtitles (VTT), transcript (TXT), metadata, and optional audio.mp3 (--with-audio) / video.mp4 (--with-video). Subtitles fast-path skips audio download entirely when official/auto subs are available. Implementation: TypeScript + Bun. ASR via whisper.cpp's whisper-cli (Metal-accelerated on Apple Silicon).
